# CJK fonts the manual needs beyond the `lxgw-fonts` TeX Live package, one
# URL per line.  The `l3build` job downloads each file, unzips the *.ttc into
# the system font directory, and caches the result under a key built from the
# hash of this file, so changing a URL invalidates the cache.
https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/releases/download/Sans2.004/03_NotoSansCJK-OTC.zip
https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/releases/download/Serif2.002/04_NotoSerifCJKOTC.zip
